clinic.heroSubtitle: TranZenDental is a cosmetic dentistry practice in North Palm Beach specializing in custom porcelain veneers, transforming discolored, chipped, or uneven teeth into durable, natural-looking smiles. Utilizing advanced technology and a holistic approach, we create camera-ready smiles that align with your overall well-being.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Consultation & Smile Analysis
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough cosmetic consultation where we discuss your smile goals, assess your oral health, and utilize advanced diagnostics like 3D CT scans for a comprehensive understanding.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Smile Design Preview & Shade Selection
treatmentJourney.description: Visualize your potential new smile with our Digital Smile Design technology. We'll work together to select the perfect shade and shape for your veneers, ensuring it complements your facial features beautifully.

treatmentJourney.title: Gentle Preparation of Teeth & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Minimal and gentle preparation of your natural teeth is performed to ensure a perfect fit for your custom veneers. Precise impressions are then taken to guide the laboratory fabrication process.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Porcelain Lab Fabrication with Temporary Veneers
treatmentJourney.description: While your custom porcelain veneers are meticulously crafted in a high-quality dental lab, you will wear comfortable, natural-looking temporary veneers, allowing you to maintain your daily routine with confidence.

treatmentJourney.title: Bonding & Final Reveal
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom veneers are carefully bonded to your teeth using a strong, durable adhesive. We ensure a precise fit and natural appearance, revealing your stunning new smile. We'll make any final adjustments for comfort and aesthetics.

treatmentJourney.title: Follow-Up Adjustments & Long-Term Care Plan
treatmentJourney.description: We schedule a follow-up visit to ensure your bite is comfortable and your new veneers feel perfect. We'll also provide a personalized long-term care plan, including hygiene tips and potential nightguard recommendations, to protect your investment.

faqItems.question: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and maintenance, porcelain veneers can last 10-15+ years, providing a durable and beautiful enhancement to your smile. Regular hygiene visits are essential to protect your investment.

faqItems.question: How many visits does veneer treatment take?
faqItems.answer: Typically, veneer treatment involves a few visits: an initial consultation and smile analysis, a preparation appointment, and a final bonding appointment. Temporary veneers are worn while your custom porcelain veneers are being crafted.

faqItems.question: Veneers vs. crowns vs. bonding — what's right for me?
faqItems.answer: During your cosmetic consultation, we'll discuss the best option for your specific needs. Veneers are ideal for aesthetic improvements, while crowns are for more damaged teeth. Bonding offers a cost-effective, same-day solution for minor enhancements.

faqItems.question: Will my teeth be ground down for veneers?
faqItems.answer: For porcelain veneers, a minimal amount of enamel is typically removed to ensure a natural fit and appearance. Our goal is to preserve as much of your natural tooth structure as possible.

faqItems.question: Do you offer financing for cosmetic dentistry?
faqItems.answer: We understand that cosmetic dentistry is an investment in your smile and confidence. Please contact our office to discuss available financing options and make your dream smile accessible.

faqItems.question: Can I see what my new smile will look like first?
faqItems.answer: Yes, through Digital Smile Design, we can create a preview of your potential new smile on screen. This allows you to visualize and fine-tune the aesthetics before any treatment begins.

doctor.name: Dr. Leconte
doctor.bio: With decades of experience in integrative and cosmetic dentistry, Dr. Leconte is dedicated to providing the highest level of personalized care. The practice emphasizes a connection between oral health and whole-body wellness, using biocompatible materials and minimally invasive techniques. Dr. Leconte believes in achieving a beautiful, healthy smile without compromising overall health, practicing mercury-free, holistic dentistry with the latest technology.
